description: The flow replay page's architecture diagram (#130): the harness as it is on main. Zones and boxes are drawn where they say (viewBox units); each box says what it is and names a repo path that exists, and each arrow joins two declared boxes (checkPage holds both). A step lights the boxes of the first sender rule its row matches (by the actor's kind, the source's kind and the event type; a rule with none of them matches any row), the box of each actor whose state or context it changed (actors: the kind of the address's last segment), and the store files it wrote (writes: always, applied when replay applied it, effects when it queued any, acks when one of them has an ack), and every arrow whose two boxes are lit.

zones.label: The lead's thread and the agents it spawns

boxes.label: The person
boxes.what: The person: files requests, answers with a tap each decision, audit and grant card the machines ask for, and may grant the stand-in decision kinds to decide alone; the lead relays each tap or message (relayedBy).

boxes.label: GitHub
boxes.what: GitHub holds the issues, PRs, reviews and CI; a PR's checks, merge or close reach the store only when the lead turns its wake into an event with harness from-github, after the REST API agrees.

boxes.label: Lead
boxes.what: The lead: the Claude Projects session that sent ORCHESTRATOR_STARTED last; it files requests, fixes each verifier's brief, spawns the workers through the spawn gate, relays GitHub wakes and the person's taps, and carries out and acks the effects.

boxes.label: Spawn gate
boxes.what: The spawn gate: the plugin's PreToolUse hook on an Agent call, which reads the brief's Harness-Role line, records the spawn as WORKER_SPAWNED for the lead, and under HARNESS_ENFORCE=1 denies a spawn the work item refuses.

boxes.label: Stand-in
boxes.what: The stand-in: an agent the lead spawns to answer a decision for the person (STAND_IN_ANSWERED: choice, confidence, reason); its answer decides only where the ladder or the person's grant lets it.

boxes.label: Triager
boxes.what: The triager: an agent the lead spawns to read the request and send TRIAGED with the tier and the criteria the item is judged by; its role lets it send nothing else (harness meta.agentEvents).

boxes.label: Builder
boxes.what: The builder: an agent the lead spawns to build the item on its branch and open the PR, and report RUN_SUCCEEDED or RUN_FAILED.

boxes.label: Verifier
boxes.what: The verifier: an agent on another model, spawned with the brief the lead fixed before the builder, which checks the PR head against each criterion (CRITERION_CHECKED) and gives its verdict (VERDICT_GIVEN).

boxes.label: Identity hooks
boxes.what: The identity hooks: before each harness call they record the call and stamp it with a fresh key, so the CLI believes which session or agent sent it, and on SubagentStart they bind the started agent to its spawn (WORKER_STARTED).

boxes.label: harness CLI · runtime
boxes.what: The harness CLI and runtime: each call takes the lock, restores the actor tree from state.json, applies one event to the addressed actor or refuses it, persists the snapshot, appends the row and queues the effects.

boxes.label: harness (root)
boxes.what: The harness root actor: takes requests and spawns a work item for each, keeps work in flight within the WIP limit and the budget, keeps the person's inbox and holds the grant.

boxes.label: work item
boxes.what: A work item actor, one per request: triage, plan gate, building, verifying, accept gate, merge gate, merging and done, with its spawns, roles, checks and verdicts.

boxes.label: decision
boxes.what: A decision actor, one per gate of an item: it asks the stand-in, decides alone only when the ladder or the grant allows, and otherwise posts a card and waits for the person's tap.

boxes.label: budget
boxes.what: The budget actor: turns usage samples into a mode (normal, wrapping up, paused) that the root schedules by.

boxes.label: audit
boxes.what: The day's stand-in audit actor: up to three decisions the stand-in made alone, put to the person on one card.

boxes.label: grant
boxes.what: A grant actor: the checklist card the person ticks to grant the stand-in decision kinds, each with its door and an end time.

boxes.label: events.jsonl
boxes.what: events.jsonl: the one history, every row the store took, appended with its version, actor, source and provenance (spec/history.schema.json).

boxes.label: steps.jsonl
boxes.what: steps.jsonl: what each history row did, written beside it by harness replay --steps; each card on this page comes from it.

boxes.label: state.json
boxes.what: state.json: the persisted snapshot of every actor, replaced whole on each write under the lock.

boxes.label: outbox.jsonl
boxes.what: outbox.jsonl: the effects the machines asked for, as data (name, subject, detail), which the lead carries out.

boxes.label: acks.jsonl
boxes.what: acks.jsonl: one row per effect carried out or withdrawn, with its outcome and note; an effect without one is still owed.

arrows.label: an Agent call with a Harness-Role brief
